import subprocess, resource, time
shapes = {
 'lists': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'[],' * 2790000 + b'[]]}',
 'dicts': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'{},' * 2790000 + b'{}]}',
 'nested2': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'[[]],' * 1390000 + b'[[]]]}',
 'deep_nested': b'{"version":1,"zz":[' + b'[[[]]],' * 930000 + b'[[[]]]]}',
 'big_rows': None,
}
# a shape with many valid-looking rows (schema violation: too many rows)
import json
rows = [{'t': i, 'values': [1, True, 'a']} for i in range(60000)]
shapes['big_rows'] = json.dumps({'version':1,'window':1,
  'schema':[{'name':'a','type':'SIZE','min':0,'max':9},{'name':'b','type':'FLAG'},{'name':'c','type':'ID','values':['a']}],
  'atoms':[],'policy':{'max_width':1,'min_support':1,'min_witness':1},
  'train':[{'id':'t','source':'s','rows':rows}],'probes':[],'queries':[]}, separators=(',',':')).encode()
for name, payload in shapes.items():
    if payload is None: continue
    t = time.time()
    p = subprocess.run(['python3','/app/submission/main.py'], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    print('%-13s bytes=%8d rc=%d %.2fs out=%s' % (name, len(payload), p.returncode, time.time()-t, p.stdout.decode().strip()[:40]))
    print('   cumulative peak RSS %.1f MiB' % (resource.getrusage(resource.RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss/1024))
PYEOF
